pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   D. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).

6. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swadaqah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nullifiers of Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues Generosity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
